findings.game: right, 80 km/h, 500 m (entry 164 m before the line, exit 164 m after); the side came from the inside-of-the-lap fallback: the only 'pit' building in scenery-data.js for it-1914 is the "Ingresso Paddock" roof (OSM way 556089654) 135 m from the track beside Arrabbiata 1 (s ~2391)
findings.real: right, 80 km/h for F1 (FIA 2020 decision car 10: "set at 80 km/h for this Event"; the OSM pit lane way's maxspeed=60 is not the F1 limit); OSM pit lane way 197788411 1014 m from 443 m before the line to 566 m after
findings.proposedFix: side / limit correct; scenery note: the real pit garages are missing and a paddock entrance roof is drawn as a pit building

findings.game: range 37.2 m; a 10 m hump at the end of the main straight (s ~550, 32.4 m above the lowest point) and a dip after Poggio Secco (s 1300-1700, 8-10 m too low)
findings.real: Toscana lidar DSM 1 m on the asphalt (median 25 m + Gauss 10 m): range 42.6 m (243.5..286.1 m ASL); 2020 car heights 43.1 m (DSM vs cars rms 1.63 m, grade rms 1.34 pp); it.wikipedia: main straight "in salita lungo 1141 m". Game vs DSM: rms 4.9 m, max 10.6 m at s 555 (213 m before T1), grade over 100 m rms 2.35 pp, max 8.4 pp; worst zones: s 575-885 (88 m before T1 / T1 Curva San Donato): game -6.1% vs 2.3%; s 390-525 (313 m before T1): game 4.9% vs 0.2%; s 945-1065 (46 m after T2 / T2 Curva Luco): game 6.3% vs 2.3%; s 1500-1605 (41 m after T4 / T4 Curva Materassi): game 2.4% vs -1.5%; s 1950-2235 (T7 / T7 Curva Savelli): game -3.1% vs -6.6%; s 1180-1310 (155 m after T3): game -4% vs -0.7%

findings.game: San Donato (T1): the braking zone and hairpin go DOWNHILL: s 450-900 -3.5 m, steepest -6.4%/100 m at s 660
findings.real: lidar: San Donato is approached and taken UPHILL: s 450-900 +12.9 m, up to +6.5%/100 m at s 810 (2020 car heights the same: 22.9 m -> 35.5 m over s 600-900). Other famous features: Arrabbiata climb +29.8 m, max +9.3%/100 m (game +30.6 m, 8.1%: ok); Casanova -> Savelli descent -35.6 m, max -8.2% (game -30.0 m, -6.6%)

findings.real: lidar DSM cross-fall across +-4 m (25 of 525 stations not planar, dropped and interpolated): median 1.4 deg, p95 5.6; corners differing by >= 2 deg: T2 Curva Luco measured -0.1 vs game 3.8; T4 Curva Materassi measured 1.1 vs game 3.1; T7 Curva Savelli measured -0.2 vs game 2.4; T8 Curva dell'Arrabbiata 1 measured 5.1 vs game 2.1; T10 Curva Scarperia measured 0 vs game 3.6 (inside-lower degrees; Arrabbiata 1 is really cambered ~5-7 deg, Scarperia / Luco / Savelli are flat)
findings.proposedFix: bankOverrides in proposedCorrections (measured), or the measured cross-fall profile; DSM caveat: a surface model, readings next to kerbs / barriers / gantries were filtered (Theil-Sen + planarity test)
